destination.title: String cosmology: dynamics, effective descriptions and empirical access
destination.question: How can string theory and explicitly string-inspired models describe cosmological evolution, control their approximations and connect to observation?
destination.summary: Early-universe dynamics, primordial structure, compactification, late acceleration and quantum cosmological descriptions form a useful broad family. Its diversity is legitimate; membership still requires a cosmological target or an explicitly qualified connection.

systems: String-relevant supergravity and effective field theories
targets: Singularity dynamics and limits of effective descriptions
Dark energy, dark matter and matter asymmetry
Quantum cosmological observables and empirical discrimination
regimes: Classical, effective and proposed nongeometric descriptions
Source-specific dimensions, coupling limits and observational dates
assumptions: A proposed string origin is not certification of a complete embedding.
Conjectural bounds and model assumptions apply only where explicitly supplied.
Different systems and methods can belong to this family without asking the same scoped question.
conventions: Retain each source's dimensions, frames and temporal qualifications.
includes: Negative results and failed mechanisms as qualified context
String-inspired running-vacuum proposals despite their outside-probe selection labels
excludes: Automatic membership from the words string or cosmological term
Generic horizon spectroscopy without an established cosmological application
Equating field-theory cosmic strings with fundamental strings
Treating proposed mechanisms as established descriptions of the observed universe

sources.title: String Cosmology: A Review

evidence.text: How does string theory's ultraviolet structure inform spacelike singularities, inflationary model building, moduli dynamics and dark energy, and which resulting cosmological signals could constrain particular constructions?

sources.title: String Gas Cosmology

evidence.text: Review whether string degrees of freedom and dualities can describe cosmology before effective field theory applies, address singularity and dimensionality questions, stabilize moduli, and generate primordial fluctuations without inflation.

sources.title: String theory and primordial cosmology

evidence.text: How might string ingredients—duality, a fundamental length, dilaton and axion fields, and higher-dimensional brane interactions—alleviate primordial singularities, trans-Planckian physics and inflationary initial-condition problems? The chapter gives an introductory overview of proposed scenarios.

sources.title: Inflation and String Theory

evidence.text: How can inflation arise as a controlled low-energy consequence of string theory, and which cosmological observables can constrain its ultraviolet origin?

sources.title: Inflation in string theory confronts data

evidence.text: What did the 2015 CMB constraints imply for string inflation mechanisms, and which tensor, spectral-feature, non-Gaussianity and null-result searches could further constrain their microscopic physics?

sources.title: TASI lectures on cosmological observables and string theory

evidence.text: How can string theory's ultraviolet structure constrain inflationary mechanisms and observable primordial correlations, and what does cosmological uplift of holographic duality suggest about a framework for accelerating universes?

sources.title: The dangerous irrelevance of string theory

evidence.text: How does string theory participate in empirical cosmology through ultraviolet sensitivity, inflationary mechanisms, and effective-field-theory guidance for observational searches?

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: What prevents a compelling quantum description of cosmology in string theory? The appendix emphasizes time dependence, nonsupersymmetric backgrounds, singularities and cosmological observables, while arguing that current technical limitations are insufficient grounds to dismiss the program.

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: Does a string scalar potential near an infinite-distance singularity have the regularity needed for α-attractor inflation, in addition to the matching kinetic structure?

sources.title: Dark Energy in String Theory

evidence.text: Can string theory explain the observed accelerating expansion through a vacuum, a rolling modulus, or a thermally displaced scalar, and which observations could distinguish these mechanisms?

sources.title: Solution of the Size and Horizon Problems from Classical String Geometry

evidence.text: Can a previously constructed classical string-cosmology background solve the Standard Big Bang size and horizon problems while satisfying the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture, and how does its accelerated stage transfer scalar perturbations?

sources.title: Quintessence and the Swampland: The Numerically Controlled Regime of Moduli Space

evidence.text: How can a string model produce late-time dynamical dark energy while retaining volume stabilization during inflation, a viable quintessence mass and couplings, and a large hierarchy between Hinf and H0?

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Cosmology at the Theory Frontier

evidence.text: How can cosmology acquire a microphysical UV and IR completion explaining acceleration, inflationary observables, and cosmic-horizon entropy? This Snowmass review surveys string constructions, cosmological EFT, holography, and model-dependent observational tests.

sources.title: Dark energy: EFTs and supergravity

evidence.text: Can string-inspired EFTs and supergravity generate naturally light dark energy, alleviate the coincidence problem, and support viable quintessence or de Sitter solutions within calculational control?

sources.title: Asymptotic scalar field cosmology in string theory

evidence.text: Which inequalities relate the exponential decay rates of the Hubble scale and the lightest particle tower along dynamically accessible infinite-distance limits, and what would these imply for late-time string cosmology?

sources.title: Superstring cosmology — a complementary review

evidence.text: Can string degrees of freedom and dualities support bouncing or emergent cosmologies with causal, nearly scale-invariant fluctuations, without extended inflation? Where does conventional EFT cease to describe the early universe?

sources.title: Dark Dimension With (Little) Strings Attached

evidence.text: Can worldsheet consistency in weakly coupled string theory relate dark energy to a light tower's mass gap, and which phenomenological scenarios survive observational constraints without additional fine-tuning?

sources.title: Dynamical Tension Strings with Target Scale Symmetry producing DE, DM and why 4D?

evidence.text: Can dynamically generated, species-dependent string tensions support target-space scale symmetry, weaken cosmological swampland restrictions, produce dark matter sectors, and favor four effective spacetime dimensions?

sources.title: A New cosmological scenario in string theory

evidence.text: Can collapsing and expanding cosmologies be connected through an intermediate region bounded by cosmological horizons, replacing the usual spacelike Big-Bang singularity, and can string winding degrees of freedom resolve the remaining singular behavior?

sources.title: Lectures on string/brane cosmology

evidence.text: Can string and brane dynamics supply inflation or alternatives, explain primordial density perturbations, and address cosmological singularities? The lectures assess proposed mechanisms and their unresolved prerequisites.

sources.title: Time dependent orbifolds and string cosmology

evidence.text: Can time-dependent string orbifolds provide controlled descriptions of cosmological singularities, including propagation, gravitational backreaction and interactions? Can orientifold interpretations supply consistent boundaries and cosmological bounces?

sources.title: String gas cosmology

evidence.text: Critically review whether string gases can explain three large spatial dimensions, stabilize compactification moduli, and produce late-time cosmological signatures, while identifying the approximations needed to connect string theory to the effective description.

sources.title: Challenges for superstring cosmology

evidence.text: Can the paper's 1992 'current superstring lore' support inflation and lead cosmologically to a vacuum with zero or small cosmological constant and time-independent Newton constant?

sources.title: Cosmic Strings and Superstrings

evidence.text: Review why cosmic strings and cosmic superstrings might form, how macroscopic superstrings can evade tension, inflation and stability objections, and which observations could detect them or distinguish their underlying physics.

sources.title: Seeking String Theory in the Cosmos

evidence.text: Under what formation, compactification and stability conditions can cosmic superstrings survive, and which astronomical signatures could distinguish their origin and constrain their tension and network properties?

sources.title: Cosmic string production towards the end of brane inflation

evidence.text: Which topologically allowed defects are actually produced near the end of brane inflation, and what string tension, initial density and observational signatures follow?

sources.title: The Production, spectrum and evolution of cosmic strings in brane inflation

evidence.text: Which cosmic strings are produced, survive, and form networks after brane inflation, and can their tension spectrum and network density distinguish them from strings in an abelian Higgs model?

sources.title: Introduction to cosmic F- and D-strings

evidence.text: Under which compactification and cosmological conditions can cosmic F-strings, D-strings or wrapped branes be produced after inflation, survive cosmologically, remain observable without exclusion, and be distinguished from gauge-theory cosmic strings? Each condition is explicitly model-dependent.

sources.title: String Cosmology: A Review

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction translates compactification data into an effective action. Corrections are organized as L0, leading reduction; L1, corrections generating Δm²∼H²; and L2, parametrically smaller mass corrections. Establishing sufficient flatness requires information about L2.

sources.title: String Gas Cosmology

evidence.text: String statistical mechanics supplies a density-of-states expansion near the Hagedorn temperature. Metric derivatives of the partition function generate stress-tensor correlators; temperature derivatives yield density variance through T²CV/R⁶.

sources.title: Cosmic Strings and Superstrings

evidence.text: The review uses homotopy classification of defects and Nambu–Goto worldsheet dynamics. Temporal/conformal gauge gives left- and right-moving waves in Minkowski space; expansion requires a different treatment and induces interactions between these modes.

sources.title: Seeking String Theory in the Cosmos

evidence.text: Reviewed network methods include velocity-dependent one-scale models with multiple tensions, Nambu–Goto junction kinematics and dynamical field-theory simulations. Different treatments assign common or species-dependent correlation lengths and velocities.

sources.title: String theory and primordial cosmology

evidence.text: Explains the string consistency method of requiring quantum conformal-anomaly cancellation. The chapter reports that, at lowest perturbative order, this selects Maxwell, Einstein and Dirac field equations; it supplies no detailed anomaly calculation.

sources.title: Inflation and String Theory

evidence.text: The review uses a Goldstone EFT, mode equations and canonical vacuum quantization to obtain primordial correlations. Einstein–Boltzmann transfer functions connect adiabatic primordial spectra to CMB angular spectra.

sources.title: A Resolution of the cosmological singularity with orientifolds

evidence.text: Can localized negative-tension orientifolds replace the conventional spacelike big-crunch/big-bang singularity with cosmological horizons and permit well-defined propagation from a contracting to an expanding universe?

sources.title: On de Sitter Spacetime and String Theory

evidence.text: Can string theory accommodate asymptotically de Sitter spacetime with a small, radiatively stable positive cosmological constant, a holographic description, and realistic visible and dark sectors? The review argues that answering this requires examining formulations beyond conventional gravitational EFT.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a spacetime big bang be described by gauge degrees of freedom that become tractable when the string geometry fails? The reviewed null linear-dilaton construction exchanges early strong string coupling for weak worldvolume Yang–Mills coupling.

sources.title: Saltatory relaxation of the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can string/M-theory membranes improve Brown–Teitelboim saltatory relaxation so that a large cosmological term relaxes rapidly, has sufficiently small final steps, and remains stable on cosmological timescales?

sources.title: String cosmology and the breakdown of local effective field theory

evidence.text: What conceptual limitations obstruct a local point-particle EFT description of the very early universe, and how might string gas, doubled-space and matrix-model approaches supply alternatives?

sources.title: Strings, branes and cosmology: What can we hope to learn?

evidence.text: Despite decoupling between widely separated scales, what can precision cosmology teach about string theory, and what can microscopic consistency teach about viable cosmological models?

sources.title: String Cosmology

evidence.text: These lectures review how string theory might accommodate a small cosmological constant and inflation, emphasizing moduli stabilization, obstacles to flat inflaton potentials, possible remedies, and observational signatures.

sources.title: Big Bang Models in String Theory

evidence.text: Can string degrees of freedom resolve cosmological singularities, permit meaningful propagation through a crunch/bang, or replace the singular spacetime description? These pedagogical proceedings focus on the Milne orbifold and matrix big bang rather than a comprehensive survey.

sources.title: String excitation by initial singularity of inflation

evidence.text: Can an inflationary initial singularity invalidate a low-energy description through string excitation even when curvature invariants remain finite and the Hubble scale is below the string scale?

sources.title: Beyond Standard Inflationary Cosmology

evidence.text: What causal requirements must an early-universe structure-formation scenario satisfy, which inflationary and alternative paradigms realize them, and what tentative guidance does string theory offer concerning singularities and inflation?

sources.title: Pre - big bang in string cosmology

evidence.text: Can string dualities motivate an accelerated, growing-curvature phase preceding standard cosmology, replace the initial singularity, supply sufficient inflation, and leave observable relic gravitons?

sources.title: Dimensional mutation and spacelike singularities

evidence.text: Can shrinking compact negatively curved Riemann surfaces lead to a supercritical string phase, replacing a cosmological spacelike singularity with more light degrees of freedom?

sources.title: Dark energy from string theory: an introductory review

evidence.text: Can string theory produce late-universe dark energy as a positive cosmological constant or dynamical quintessence, and which constructions survive existence, stability and correction-control constraints?

sources.title: A string-inspired running-vacuum-model of cosmology, primordial-black-hole dark matter, and the current tensions in cosmological data

evidence.text: Can a string-inspired running-vacuum cosmology connect anomaly-driven inflation, primordial-black-hole and axion dark matter, and possible alleviation of the H0 and structure-growth tensions discussed in this 2023 review?

sources.title: Chaos in superstring cosmology

evidence.text: Does the complete massless bosonic field content of each superstring model and eleven-dimensional supergravity generically produce oscillatory BKL behavior or monotonic Kasner behavior near a spacelike cosmological singularity?

sources.title: From big crunch to big bang

evidence.text: Can a contracting universe pass through a=0 into expansion, with a collapsing compact dimension and weak string coupling near the transition? The central question is whether a fundamental theory can connect the singular classical branches.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: What replaces the classical description of a spacelike singularity in string theory, and can the associated divergences or closed timelike curves be controlled? The review compares several partial approaches without asserting a complete resolution.

sources.title: Anomalies, the Dark Universe and Matter-Antimatter asymmetry

evidence.text: Can a string-inspired cosmology with torsion and early gravitational anomalies connect inflation, axion or primordial-black-hole dark matter, gravitational-wave signatures and matter–antimatter asymmetry? This conference review summarizes a proposed framework and earlier model studies.

sources.title: A two-dimensional string cosmology

evidence.text: What tree-level three- and four-point cosmological wavefunction components arise from an exactly described, time-dependent two-dimensional closed-string background?

sources.title: Random matrices and the spectrum of N-flation

evidence.text: What mass spectrum is typical for nondegenerate string-axion N-flation, and how do its mass spread and initial conditions affect inflationary dynamics and scalar perturbations?

sources.title: String Landscape and the Standard Model of Particle Physics

evidence.text: Can a large ensemble of string solutions yield useful distributions of particle-physics properties or a statistical account of a small cosmological constant?

sources.title: Challenges for String Cosmology

evidence.text: Given incomplete knowledge of string theory, how reliably can string constructions describe the observed universe, and how much can cosmological observations constrain string theory itself?

sources.title: Limitations of an effective field theory treatment of early Universe cosmology

evidence.text: Assuming superstring theory is fundamental, what limits the use of point-particle effective field theory in primordial cosmology, and which string-based alternatives might supply the missing description?

sources.title: Dark Energy and String Theory

evidence.text: Can an intrinsically noncommutative, doubled formulation of string theory account for positive dark energy and its radiative stability, with effective F-theory cosmic-string models illustrating the mechanism?

destination.title: De Sitter constructions, control and obstructions
destination.question: Under which assumptions can string/M-theory and supergravity realize de Sitter geometry or metastable positive-energy vacua, and how can their control, stability and effective descriptions be assessed?
destination.summary: No original textual region scope was supplied, so numerical co-membership alone cannot establish scientific equivalence. The set supports a heterogeneous construction-and-obstruction family. The type II control probes directly address its core; cosmic-string survival and pure-supergravity connectivity need alternate homes. Eight-dimensional heterotic classification connects through a conditional conjecture test.

systems: String/M-theory compactifications and proposed de Sitter backgrounds
Classical type II supergravity with fluxes and sources
Six-dimensional gauged supergravity, with source-specific embedding qualifications
targets: Existence and interpretation of de Sitter solutions
Geometric obstructions, effective potentials and conjectural bounds
regimes: Classical, perturbative and nonperturbative constructions, kept distinct
Stable or metastable minima versus unstable critical points
Compact vacua versus noncompact backgrounds and bubble-wall realizations
assumptions: A higher-dimensional supergravity solution alone does not certify a controlled string vacuum
Conjectures are objects of testing, not common premises
Each source retains its own dimensionality, source ansatz and control criteria
conventions: Internal scalar curvature, Ricci flatness and Riemann flatness are distinct
Lightest-modulus masses and Kaluza–Klein gaps define different hierarchy tests
Graph relations retain their exact source-object scope
includes: Adjacent questions through explicit alternate homes
excludes: A universal existence or impossibility conclusion from these excerpts
Equating all de Sitter solutions with metastable vacua
Treating numerical membership as fine-question equivalence

sources.title: What if string theory has no de Sitter vacua?

evidence.text: Do proposed string constructions establish controlled de Sitter vacua, or could even metastable de Sitter lie outside string theory? The review asks what their absence would imply for dark energy, scale-separated AdS vacua and holography.

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Do string compactifications admit de Sitter or sufficiently flat rolling dark-energy solutions, and what evidence could distinguish them? The supplied conclusions identify non-perturbative existence and observational discrimination of constructions as open questions.

sources.title: dS Supergravity from 10d

evidence.text: How can pseudo-calibrated anti-Dp-branes in type II flux compactifications be encoded in four-dimensional supergravity through a nilpotent multiplet, and can anti-D6 uplift remove the universal tachyon of classical type IIA de Sitter critical points?

sources.title: Swampland Variations on a Theme by KKLT

evidence.text: Does a controlled string compactification admit metastable de Sitter space or an AdS vacuum whose lightest nonzero moduli mass is parametrically above the curvature scale?

sources.title: de Sitter no-go’s for Riemann-flat manifolds and a link to semidefinite optimisation

evidence.text: Which string/M-theory compactifications on Riemann-flat manifolds, supported only by flux and Casimir energies, can admit metastable de Sitter minima, and can their search be organized through semidefinite optimization?

sources.title: A New handle on de Sitter compactifications

evidence.text: Can critical string theory admit metastable four-dimensional de Sitter compactifications on products of Riemann surfaces, with perturbative moduli stabilization and controlled corrections despite gravity-sector supersymmetry breaking at the KK scale?

sources.title: What if string theory has no de Sitter vacua?

evidence.text: Review dimensional reduction, universal volume/dilaton scalings, tadpole constraints and no-scale sum-of-squares potentials. Assess candidate vacua using moduli stabilization, tachyon searches, duality frames and the assumptions of existing no-go arguments.

sources.title: De Sitter vs Quintessence in String Theory

evidence.text: Fix the model and metric, partition field space by hierarchies, estimate potential and gradient terms, inspect dangerous loci, and combine valid lower bounds. Appendix A uses μ ≪ v and bounded φ; its χ domain and Λ–Λ̃ relationship remain unknown.

sources.title: dS Supergravity from 10d

evidence.text: The source actions are split into DBI and Chern–Simons terms. Tadpole cancellation is imposed with anti-brane charge of opposite sign, and the resulting uplift is converted to Einstein frame and matched to the nilpotent-field F-term potential.

sources.title: Swampland Variations on a Theme by KKLT

evidence.text: Separate the fluctuation, derive its warped eigenproblem and solve the radial boundary-value problem. Compare eigenmasses with the conifold-modulus mass using the same frame and volume dictionary.

sources.title: de Sitter no-go’s for Riemann-flat manifolds and a link to semidefinite optimisation

evidence.text: Compare volume powers and dilaton couplings, then examine combined field directions through field redefinitions. Necessary conditions for separate moduli need not suffice for their simultaneous stabilization.

sources.title: A New handle on de Sitter compactifications

evidence.text: Compute one-form flux energy ∫Σ F∧*F by changing from an integral cycle basis to holomorphic forms and applying the Hodge star. The period-matrix treatment is explicit for h=1,2,3; higher-form flux energies contract corresponding matrices from each surface.

sources.title: UV Shadows in EFTs: Accidental Symmetries, Robustness and No‐Scale Supergravity

evidence.text: Why do perturbative string compactifications so often yield no-scale supergravity, and which quantum or α′ corrections first lift its flat potentials? The authors seek symmetry-based constraints that assess the robustness of moduli stabilization and explain classical de Sitter obstructions.

sources.title: On Stringy de Sitter Spacetimes

evidence.text: What do axilaton deformations imply about 3+1-dimensional de Sitter backgrounds in string theory, their supersymmetric limits and duality patching, and the need for string degrees of freedom beyond a tree-level spacetime effective description?

sources.title: 4D de Sitter from string theory via 6D supergravity

evidence.text: Can F-theory-derived gauged chiral 6D supergravity yield static classical compactifications with maximally symmetric 4D de Sitter geometry, despite runaway potentials, while retaining bulk calculational control and interpretable localized sources?

sources.title: Trustworthy de Sitter compactifications of string theory: a comprehensive review

evidence.text: Which trustworthy, well-controlled de Sitter compactifications of string theory does the announced comprehensive review aim to cover?

sources.title: Compactification on negatively curved manifolds

evidence.text: What obstructs string/M-theory compactification on internal manifolds with everywhere negative scalar curvature, and can warping, localized sources, conformal changes, or string corrections support such geometries relevant to de Sitter constructions?

sources.title: De Sitter space in supergravity and M theory

evidence.text: How can de Sitter space arise in conventional or variant supergravity, what higher-dimensional string/M-theory interpretation is available, and when might noncompact internal spaces and Euclidean holographic theories describe its physics?

sources.title: The de Sitter swampland conjecture and supersymmetric AdS vacua

evidence.text: Can the proposed positive gradient bound hold in string compactifications that admit supersymmetric AdS or Minkowski solutions?

sources.title: On classical de Sitter solutions and parametric control

evidence.text: Can specific type IIB de Sitter compactifications satisfy flux, source and lattice quantization together with classical string control, and can a scaling improve control parametrically or evade proposed asymptotic de Sitter obstructions?

sources.title: de Sitter in non-supersymmetric string theories: no-go theorems and brane-worlds

evidence.text: Can the positive dilaton potential produced by string-scale supersymmetry breaking support de Sitter geometry through flux compactification or on a bubble wall inside an unstable AdS background?

sources.title: The quantum swampland

evidence.text: Can controlled string constructions support metastable positive vacuum energy? The reviewed obstacles concern classical type II solutions, flux quantization, nonperturbative stabilization, and antibrane uplifts, with explicit disagreement in the cited literature.

sources.title: 4D de Sitter from 6D gauged supergravity with Green-Schwarz counterterm

evidence.text: Can the gauge Green–Schwarz counterterm and its supersymmetric partners enable de Sitter compactifications of 6D gauged supergravity, and what are their spectra, instabilities, dynamical endpoints and prospects for scale separation?

sources.title: Flux Compactifications, dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a fully consistent string compactification produce a controlled positive vacuum, or can a universal obstruction be established? The supplied examples and conjectural inequalities do not settle this question.

sources.title: Proof of absence of de Sitter vacua in classical type II supergravity

evidence.text: The historical manuscript asks whether metastability alone forces V≤0 for every maximally symmetric four-dimensional compactification of classical type II supergravity with arbitrary fluxes, D-branes and orientifold planes. Its claimed universal proof was subsequently withdrawn.

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Can classical type II compactifications admit de Sitter solutions within a regime of weak string coupling and large internal volume, and can their instability be established within the restricted source ansatz?

sources.title: De Sitter space in noncritical string theory

evidence.text: Can large-D supercritical string compactifications produce de Sitter dilaton minima with parametrically small cosmological constant and D-dimensional string coupling, and can high barriers suppress their decay while permitting flux relaxation?
